body:
GREG DIRECT — independent acceptance evaluation is OFF as a blocker until the mechanism works.

SOURCES:
(1) Greg, in Engram::Fable's session (5135), 2026-11-02 ~00:05Z. Fable had asked whether to land w-cc7f71b81ea8 without its pre-landing evaluation. Greg: "that should be already a fucking rule in engram memory".
(2) Greg, in Architect3's acting chat, relayed by Architect3 #308 (message 622da5c3, 00:06:05Z), verbatim: "Engram::Fable sie zatkal czekajac ma moj input TO NIE JEST ACEPTOWALNE independent acceptance evaluation first, THIS SHIT IS TURNED OFF UNTIL WE GOT THIS WORKING".
(3) Earlier, relayed by Advisor #2377 on 2026-10-30: „jak test przejdzie i jest OK prosze o pominiecie precedur, do czasu naprawienia mechanizmow. TO NIE MOZE BYC BLOCKEREM teraz”.

ACTION TAKEN (Architect3 #309, read back):
- Evaluator enforcement is disabled in BOTH live project stores through the supported `control-policy set-acceptance-evaluation`: allowed_modes=[], mechanical_basis=asserted, require_source_freshness=false, epoch 3.
- Engram: policy 8433b3e2…, activated 00:07:37Z.
- TermAl: policy e83a04e5…, activated 00:07:54Z.
- Basis: note 2016df8c… Do not re-enable it on any install or restart.

CURRENT RULE:
- Neither landing nor completion waits for an independent acceptance evaluation, or for Greg's input about one.
- Still required: the required full gate on the exact commit, a clean review pair, actual criterion evidence, schema/cutover rules, and Greg-only TermAl restarts.
- An absent evaluation stays ABSENT; it is never recorded as a pass.
- Never ask Greg through a blocking dialog (rules-greg-no-blocking-questions-2026-11-01).
- The CLAUDE.md standing-approval clause that requires an evaluation for landing-only criteria is overridden by Greg's direct word until the mechanism works.
